build_mel_spectrogram_model: build a MelSpectrogramModel that converts audio waveforms into mel spectrograms using torchaudio transforms
create_model_config: create a ModelConfig dataclass with n_fft, win_length, hop_length, and n_mels parameters for mel spectrogram settings
load_model_for_inference: load a MelSpectrogramModel into eval mode on the specified device using the load_model function
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the MelSpectrogramModel with a dict containing audio and audio_sample_rate keys
get_mel_spectrogram_transform: get a torchaudio MelSpectrogram transform configured with the model config parameters and sample rate
